text: [[col:red]]Foreign agent.[[/col]] This character is an undercover operative working for another faction. Your counter-espionage has seen through their cover.
[[col:green]]Open to persuasion.[[/col]] This character could be turned into an undercover agent, and their loyalty is low enough that they would accept the offer.
[[col:green]]Loyal.[[/col]] This character is willing to serve as an undercover agent for your purpose.
This character can never serve as an undercover agent.
Your counter-espionage is not strong enough to judge this character. Increase your spy defence to see through their cover.
No counter-espionage report for this character. If you see this on everyone, the mod is not receiving data.
[[col:yellow]]Under suspicion.[[/col]] Something about this character does not sit right. Your counter-espionage cannot yet tell whether they serve another master or are simply loyal to you.
Your agents watch the court. Weak infiltrators can no longer hide from you.
A disciplined web of informants. Most foreign agents are exposed.
Nothing said in your halls escapes you. Even veteran agents are laid bare.
